props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Read our [Composition](https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/composition) guide for more details.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the pin input when initially rendered.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the pin input.

props.name: mask
props.description: When `true`, inputs render as password fields.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the pin input. Can be bound with `v-model`.

props.name: otp
props.description: When `true`, enables one-time-code autofill on mobile.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder character shown in empty inputs.

props.name: type
props.description: The value type for the inputs.
